paper_title: Can Language Models Follow Multiple Turns of Entangled Instructions
caption: consists of 1.1K spanning across three levels of difficulty and 9 capabilities, with balanced numbers of samples in each capability (numbers shown in the figure). Table <ref> provides a more detailed list of task descriptions.
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the distribution of 1,100 instruction-following tasks across nine distinct capabilities, organized into three higher-level categories: “Contradiction Resolution,” “Context Tracking,” and “Context Retrieving.” Each capability is represented by a colored segment in the outer ring, with its corresponding numerical count displayed adjacent to the label. The “Contradiction Resolution” category includes “Prioritization” (100), “Personalization” (100), and “Privacy Protection” (111). “Context Tracking” encompasses “Triggering” (100), “Recursive Reasoning” (110), and “Dynamic Environment” (100). “Context Retrieving” contains “Memorization” (100), “Dynamic Instruction” (100), and “Multitasking” (160), which is the largest single segment. The inner ring visually groups these capabilities under their respective categories, with each category occupying a distinct color-coded wedge. The numbers suggest a mostly balanced distribution across capabilities, though “Multitasking” and “Privacy Protection” slightly exceed the nominal 100 per capability, reflecting the total of 1,100 tasks mentioned in the caption.
